newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities market closed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities market closed.

text.p: The Singapore government securities market was closed on Thursday for the May Day holiday. It will reopen on Friday.

On Wednesday, in treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 1.49/1.44 percent compared with Tuesday's yield of 1.45/1.40 percent but one-year was unchanged from Tuesday's yield of 1.60/1.55 percent.

Among bonds, April 1999 ended at S$99.60/99.65 against Tuesday's close of S$99.58/99.63, September 2001 was unchanged from Tuesday's S$96.89/96.94 and June 2003 ended at $S94.90/94.95 versus S$94.89/94.94.
The interbank rate eased slightly to 3-3/8 3-1/4 percent against Tuesday's 3-7/16 3-5/16 percent.
